name: Formula Nano
description: Designs, builds, and races molecular machines at the nanoscale, competing in the international Nanocar Race using scanning tunneling microscopy.

cycles.notes: No separate general-member tier: everyone joins through a role-specific application on the jobs page (Chemistry, Instrumentation, Computation, or Business), each with a short technical screening form plus a casual interview. Every posting shows the same Apply by 9/26/2025 deadline, over a year stale, but the FAQ says R&D is continuous and new members are welcome anytime, so treat that date as leftover template text, not a real cutoff. Leadership isn't separately advertised, the site's team page just lists the current leads.
